author: ukSpeedo
name: FlashNDash
short: Temporary channel posts that auto-delete after a chosen or configured duration.
description: Watches a configurable channel, chooses a deletion duration using DM buttons or a duration in the post text, optionally pings a configurable role, then deletes the post and ping when time is up.
install_msg: Thanks for installing FlashNDash! Use `[p]flashndash` to configure it. `[p]fnd` remains available as an alias.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores Discord message, channel and guild IDs until scheduled posts are deleted. It does not persistently store any user data.
